# Game Center
English | 中文
## English
A DeepSeek Harness panel plugin that keeps the mini-games built for this harness in one place, and l
ets you play them without leaving the window. Ships with Tetris and Cops & Robbers.
### Requirements

| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.5` or newer (Web UI; verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`) |
| Node.js | `>= 22`

|
| npm dependencies | none at runtime — the panel injects `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` and `@de
epseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, which the harness provides |
### Install
The plugin is listed in the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog, so it appears in **dshmarket** and in DSH's
**Plugins → Discover**: search for *Game Center*, *游戏中心* or *Tetris* and click **Install**. That is
ver**: search for *Game Center*, *游戏中心* or *Tetris* and click **Install**. That is the easiest path.
It is also published through three channels you can install from directly:
| Channel | Command | Notes |
| dshmarket / Discover | search **Game Center** | one-click; the catalog entry lives in awesome-dsh-

plugin |
| npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-game-center` | prebuilt `dsh-game-center@1.0.1`;

no build scripts, so no `allowBuilds` prompt |
| GitHub Release tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web
add "https://github.com/stallenlu/dsh-game-center/releases/latest/download/dsh-game-center.tgz"` | p

rebuilt; the asset name carries no version, so the URL keeps working after upgrades |
| Git source |
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:stallenlu/dsh-game-center` | always the current `main`; a code
ile web add github:stallenlu/dsh-game-center` | always the current `main`; a code push needs no PR |
With a single profile, `dsh plugin add …` works the same without `--profile web`.
Restart DSH afterwards — a full restart, not just a Web UI refresh, for a first install — then open
**Game Center** from the sidebar.
### What it does
- **One list for the games.** The panel is a game library: each game is a card with a picture built
from the game itself, its name, category, version and status, and it plays in the same panel — no ne

w tab or window.
- **Tetris.** A 10×20 board, seven pieces with wall kicks, a ghost piece, a next-pi
ece preview, line-clear scoring, levels that speed the falling piece up, pause/restart, and a best s

core kept in `localStorage`.
- **Cops & Robbers.** Play the thief on a walled grid: collect every pi
ece of loot to clear the level while the police hunt you down. They path around the walls toward you

, each level sends one more, and three lives stand between you and game over.
- **Per-game difficult
y.** Difficulty is the game's own setting, chosen on its start screen and remembered per game: Easy
/ Normal / Hard start Tetris at level 1 / 3 / 5 and give Cops & Robbers 1 / 2 / 3 police; the level

still rises as you play.
- **Settings.** The panel's own settings only: show or hide the sidebar ent
ry, and reset to defaults. Reachable from the gear button in the panel header and from the plugin's

page under **Plugins**.
- **Theme.** Colours come from the harness theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), s
o the panel follows light and dark mode.
### Controls
**Tetris**
| Key | Action |

| `←` `→` | Move |
| `↑` `X` | Rotate |
| `↓` | Soft drop |
| `Space` | Hard drop |
| `P` | Pause |
**Cops & Robbers**
| Key | Action |

| `W` `A` `S` `D` | Move one cell |
| `←` `↑` `↓` `→` | Move one cell |
| `P` | Pause |

### Adding a game
`client.js` has a `GAMES` registry; an entry declares `{ id, nameKey, descKey, categoryKey, version,
statusKey, thumb, thumbCell, thumbGap, render(t) }` and appears in the library automatically. `rend
er` receives the translate function and returns the game's element. A new game also needs its string
s added to the `zh` / `en` dictionaries registered at the top of `apply()`.
**The card's picture must come from the game, not from decoration.** Write a `xxxThumb()` that build
s the matrix out of that game's own constants — a board, a map, its real colours — and set `thumbCel
l` / `thumbGap` so it fits the 104px panel. Both shipped games do this (`tetrisThumb()` drops real p
ieces through `SHAPES` / `COLORS` / `collides`, `chaseThumb()` draws `CHASE_MAP`), and `verify.mjs`
asserts for every registered game that the picture is a non-blank grid of equal-width rows holding c
olours — so a hand-drawn or empty one fails the check. Note `.gc-thumb` is a `grid`: it used to be a
`flex` row, which laid a 2D matrix out as one clipped line of cells.
### 环境要求

| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.5` 或更新（Web UI；已在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 验证） |
| Node.js | `>= 22` |
| npm 依赖 |
运行时无依赖——面板只注入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`，由 harness 提供 |
### 功能

- **一个列表管理游戏。** 面板本身就是游戏库：每款游戏一张卡片，带一张由游戏本身生成的示意图、名称、分类、版本与状态，点开就在同一面板里游玩，不新开标签页或窗口。
- **俄罗斯方块。** 10

×20 棋盘、七种方块（含靠墙微调）、落点虚影、下一个方块预览、消行计分、等级越高落得越快、暂停/重开，最高分存在 `localStorage`。
- **警察抓小偷。** 你扮演小偷，在有墙的棋盘上

把赃物全部捡走即可过关，同时要躲开追捕的警察。警察会绕开墙走最短路线追你，每过一关多一个警察，你有三条命。
- **每个游戏自己的难度。** 难度是游戏自身的设置，在各自的开始界面上选择、按游戏分别记

住：简单 / 普通 / 困难分别让俄罗斯方块从第 1 / 3 / 5 级开始，并让警察抓小偷开局有 1 / 2 / 3 个警察；等级仍会随游玩继续上升。
- **设置。** 只放面板自身的设置：显示或

隐藏侧边栏入口，以及恢复默认。面板右上角的齿轮按钮和插件页都能打开。
- **主题。** 配色取自 harness 主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），明暗主题自动跟随。
